subject: Request: latest penetration test report for Hosted API & secure delivery options
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: ACME Security <security@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: latest pen test report for Hosted API (scope & transfer)

Hi Ben,

We're preparing for our SIG review and need the most recent penetration test report you can share for Redwood's Hosted API (the endpoints our service talks to). A few clarifying asks: 

- Can you confirm the scope (external blackbox vs internal config review) and the test date/vendor?
- Do you provide a redacted executive summary for distribution to our legal/compliance team, in addition to the full report?
- What's your preferred secure transfer mechanism? Our policy requires either a vendor portal or a time-limited encrypted download (we can accept an S3 presigned + password).
- Please include a short remediation status table (ticket IDs, brief status, and ETA) for high/critical findings.

We can sign an NDA if needed. ETA for the SIG packet is 2025-08-21, so quick turnaround would be appreciated — an exec summary first would be ideal.

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Park
Security Operations
Acme Corp
security@acme.com

--
Attachments: none

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme.com>
Cc: ACME Security <security@acme.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: latest pen test report for Hosted API (scope & transfer)

Hi Daniel — thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely support this. Quick answers up front, then options and next steps: 

Scope and vendor:
- The latest assessment was performed in May 2025 by PenTestCo (third-party). Scope = external black-box against our Hosted API endpoints + authenticated endpoint review for the management plane; it does not include customer PII/data.

Deliverables we can provide: 
- Redacted executive summary (PDF) suitable for distribution to legal/compliance.
- Full penetration test report with standard redactions (no customer data) under NDA.
- A remediation spreadsheet summarizing each high/critical finding, ticket ID (internal JIRA), current state, and ETA.

Secure transfer options (pick one):
1) Temporary protected S3 presigned URL + one-time passphrase (24 hours).
2) Secure portal (we can provision an account for your security team).
3) Encrypted archive (.7z AES-256) with password delivered over a separate channel.

Next steps we suggest:
- If you confirm option (1) or (3) we will send the exec summary immediately and upload the full report after NDA is executed.
- I attached our mutual NDA template (redwood_mutual_nda_template.pdf) — we can also sign your standard agreement.

Laura, looping you in to confirm remediation status and whether there are any outstanding items we should surface.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: redwood_mutual_nda_template.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme.com>
Cc: ACME Security <security@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 08:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: latest pen test report for Hosted API (scope & transfer)

Hi all — Laura from Security. Quick remediation snapshot pulled from our tracker (high/critical only):

- RED-4521: SQLi in analytics ingest endpoint — mitigated 2025-06-03, patch rolled, verified by PenTestCo retest.
- RED-4590: Token leakage in dev logs — remediation deployed 2025-07-12; verification in progress (low confidence). ETA for verification: 2025-08-22.
- RED-4628: Outdated library (TLS stack) flagged — library upgraded and tested 2025-06-20, monitoring rule added.

I'll attach a concise remediation_summary_ACME_20250815.xlsx with ticket links and rubrics. Executive summary is ready as exec_summary_redwood_pt_2025-05.pdf — I can push that right away.

Transfer preference: we recommend an S3 presigned link with 24-hour expiry plus a one-time password (opt 1 above). We will rotate the password via a separate email to the ACME security inbox.

If you prefer a DocuSign NDA instead of our template, share the link and we will countersign same day.

Laura Bennett
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachments: remediation_summary_ACME_20250815.xlsx, exec_summary_redwood_pt_2025-05.pdf

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: ACME Security <security@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: latest pen test report for Hosted API (scope & transfer)

Ben/Laura — thanks, that timeline works for us. We'll sign the mutual NDA and prefer the S3 presigned link + separate password delivery. A couple quick asks before you upload the full report: 

- Please send the exec summary (PDF) first so our legal can include in the SIG packet.
- In the remediation spreadsheet, can you mark which items have external CVE references vs internal findings? That helps our triage.
- Password delivery to security@acme.com is fine — please mark the email subject with "Redwood PT password".

We'll aim to return the signed NDA by EOD tomorrow. If you can provide the exec summary this AM, that would be ideal.

Appreciate the quick coordination.

—Daniel
Daniel Park
Security Operations
Acme Corp
security@acme.com
